title: Every seeder module tracy-web loads imports from the image layout, so WordPress briefs no longer fail at prepare
steps: S1: Run node --test scripts/test/tracy-web-seeder-image.test.mjs: it copies packages/cms/tracy-seeder/src alone into a temporary src/seeder (the apps/tracy-web/Dockerfile COPY line, which it also asserts) and imports each name in SEEDER_MODULES of apps/tracy-web/src/lib/seeder.js in a fresh Node process.

S2: Run node --test --test-name-pattern='without the language catalogue' packages/cms/tracy-seeder/test/wordpress-contract-door.test.mjs: the seeder src is copied with wordpress-language-packs.json removed, the door is imported and setWordPressLocale is called for vi-vn.
expect: S1: every module loads, wordpress-contract-door included (no ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND).
S2: the door imports; setWordPressLocale returns status none, makes no door call, and warns that WordPress could not be told to speak vi-vn.
evidence: Since PR 1019 every WordPress brief on cowork.tracy.site failed: wordpress-contract-door imported ../../tracy-wordpress-quickstart/language-packs.json, which the tracy-web image does not carry (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND at prepare).
fence: The seeder's runtime modules may not import outside their own src directory; a catalogue that cannot be read costs only the language step.
